items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Diosa Costelo was a top name in that particular time... she heard about Machito because she used to live in the barrio too.

ctx.x: Okay. Macho, who was some of the bands that worked opposite you at the Park Plaza for the time that you worked there?
Well, Orquesta Siboney, ahh, Augusto Coen, Noro Morales - few times - and then, Diosa Costelo. She is responsible for whatever we have now.
